description: Defines a Vue.js component 'media-items-table' for displaying and interacting with media items in a table format, including sorting, selection, renaming, deleting, and viewing media.

classes.name: media-items-table
classes.description: A Vue.js component for rendering a media items table with sorting, selection, and media management functionalities.

methods.name: isMediaSelected
methods.description: Checks if a media item is currently selected based on its URL.

methods.name: buildMediaUrl
methods.description: Constructs a media URL with specified thumbnail size parameters.

methods.name: changeSort
methods.description: Requests sorting change for the media items based on a specified column.

methods.name: toggleSelectionOfMedia
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of a media item.

methods.name: renameMedia
methods.description: Triggers a rename action for a media item.

methods.name: deleteMedia
methods.description: Triggers a delete action for a media item.

methods.name: dragStart
methods.description: Initiates a drag operation for a media item.

methods.name: printDateTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a locale-specific date-time string.

methods.name: getfontAwesomeClassNameForFileName
methods.description: Generates a Font Awesome class name based on filename and thumbnail size.
